newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus falls 9.8 pct in profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Optimus falls 9.8 pct in profit-taking.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA fell 9.8 percent in heavy trade to 83 zlotys in profit-taking after the stock had surged over 100 percent this month until Monday. On Tuesday the stock fell 4.7 percent.
"It's a textbook profit-taking correction -- the stock rose from about 60 zlotys to well over 90 in about two weeks," one trader said.

Analysts expected the stock to level out on Thursday, with some saying growth was possible. They said Optimus had gained in part from strong 1996 earnings, which the firm has said it might repeat this year. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
